## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe what this fixes or adds. Link the related issue if available.

## Validation

List commands/results and mark Windows/GPU cases you could not test as NOT TESTED.
Include screenshots for UI changes or diagnostic logs for rendering/Shell changes.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and preserves existing user data/active scenes on failure.
- [ ] Relevant tests and documentation were updated, including README translations when needed.
- [ ] Added scenes/assets are original or authorized, with license/rights evidence included (or no assets added).
- [ ] Dependency notices/source obligations were retained (or no dependency changes).
- [ ] No credentials, personal logs, build outputs, or downloaded runtime binaries are committed.

Security vulnerabilities must be reported privately using SECURITY.md, not disclosed here.
